About

I'm an independent product designer
based in Seattle, Washington.

I create successful products experiences from the ground up. UX and CX,
UI to AI, my multiple displinary approach is grounded in empathy and craft.

This mix of concept to implementation helps me see the full picture from concept to execution and ensure every detail, visible or not, supports the larger vision.

Design is changing fast — and I think that's a good thing. I bring curiosity and resilience to every shift, including AI. Rather than resisting the tools that are redefining the craft, I lean in with grit and a designer's eye, using them to move faster, think bigger, and stay closer to what actually matters: the people on the other end of the experience.

Values

Details

The things that seem small — spacing, timing, a label that actually makes sense — are usually what separates work that earns trust from work that merely exists.

Curiosity

Better answers come from staying genuinely open: to new tools, unfamiliar domains, and problems that don't have a template yet. Especially those.

People

The measure of good design isn't how it looks in a Figma frame. It's whether it helps someone do something they care about, on the worst day they've had all week.

Background

Lead Product Designer

Led design across a full web platform redesign and multiple zero-to-one products — including genomics tools, clinical data portals, and internal dashboards. Managed design systems and mentored junior designers.

Design Director

Led and executed design across product and brand for a nature-exposure health tech startup. Directed brand identity, built the design function from scratch, and shipped NatureDose and NatureScore consumer apps.

Product Designer

Designed product experiences across a portfolio of consumer apps including Moodhacker, Jauntly, and CBT-based wellness programs. Led branding, UI, and UX, conducted user research, and wrote front-end code for UI.

Freelance Independent
2008–Present · Remote

Designer & Creative Director

Ongoing independent practice spanning product design, brand identity, data visualization, and front-end development for clients including Reuters, Stack Overflow, St. Jude, REI Cooperative Action Fund, and XPRIZE.
